summary: Iteration 3 — FixiPro rebrand + 15% commission + live quotes verification. Backend pytest suite expanded to 27 tests (added rebrand/settings/categories/fee sanity + previous iter1/2 tests); ALL 27/27 GREEN including the previously-failing brute_force_lockout (main agent's tz-datetime fix from iter2 is verified working). Frontend smoke test across all 13 public routes: every page renders with FixiPro branding, correct title 'FixiPro | Trusted Local Handymen', new header (FP tile + FixiPro.co.uk/UK MARKETPLACE, navy announcement bar, 5-item pill nav [Services⌄, How It Works, Handyman, About Us, Help & Support], Login + blue Register pill), zero occurrences of 'ServiceHub' or 'tradesman/tradesperson' in body text on any page. Services mega-menu hover shows all 8 categories (Plumbing, Electrical, Cleaning, Gardening, Painting & Decorating, Handyman, General Repairs, Appliance Repair) with icons + descriptions; General Repairs click filters /services?category=general-repairs correctly. Hero search card has all 4 data-testids (hero-q, hero-postcode, hero-service-select, hero-search-btn). No £ price amounts on public /services list. /pricing page contains '15%' and '£0' and NO '10%'. Contact page renders mailto:hello.fixipro@gmail.com and tel:+447538624492 links, spline-viewer web component with data-testid contact-spline-bg present, no console errors from spline load. Backend confirms: GET /api/ returns 'FixiPro API', settings.support_email = hello.fixipro@gmail.com, PLATFORM_FEE_PCT = 15.0, /api/categories returns 8 (incl. general-repairs, appliance-repair), /api/services returns 19. LIVE-QUOTE POLLING (core new feature) verified end-to-end: created a NEW customer request via API, opened /dashboard/requests/{id} as customer, submitted a £140 provider quote via API, and WITHOUT any refresh the customer page auto-updated within ~2.1s — quote card with 'Carter Home Services Ltd £140.00 Pending' appeared, header changed 'Quotes (0)'→'Quotes (1)', 'Live' pulsing indicator remained visible, green toast '1 new quote just arrived' popped, status flipped Open→Quoted, Accept/Decline buttons rendered. Not executed via UI: the full Stripe hosted-checkout payment path + provider start/complete + /pro/earnings £119/£21 split UI verification (requires driving external Stripe pages; main agent can self-test — backend fee math is 15% by constant, and prior iterations verified job completion writes provider_earnings rows).
action_items: Main agent may self-verify the £119/£21 (85/15) split on /pro/earnings by manually completing the accepted £140 quote created during this test (Stripe test card 4242): request title 'TEST_ Live Quote 52a569'. Fee math is 15% via PLATFORM_FEE_PCT constant so no further code work expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Rebrand is comprehensive at both HTML and API surface — no residual ServiceHub/tradesman strings detected. Good.

Live-quote polling implemented via setInterval(4s) on RequestDetail — fires as expected. Consider switching to SSE or WebSocket if scale becomes a concern (each open detail page hits /api/requests/{id} every 4s).
Pre-login pages issue 401s on /api/auth/me and /api/notifications — noisy in devtools; consider gating those calls behind an auth-known state to keep the console clean.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all executed flows (13/13 public pages rebranded, mega-menu, hero search, contact mailto/tel + spline, pricing 15%, live-quote polling with toast)
